title: Menara Kudus Mosque

buildingCutout.basis: The OSM outline of the rear roof control. Detached mosque structures are placed using the cited precinct controls.

terrainReference.basis: Original elevation in front of the mosque entrance facing Jalan Menara.

mapIdentity.provider: Ministry of Religious Affairs mosque register, OSM and Overture building controls

identities.name: Menara Kudus Mosque
identities.address: Jalan Menara, Kauman, Kota Kudus, Central Java, Indonesia

mapIdentity.scope: Named ministry and OSM records, documented southeast minaret position and field dimensions, and photographed relationship between the tower and the mosque front.

note: The mosque has a silver-domed east entry with pale walls, green parapet and paired capped pilasters. The southeast minaret is roughly 18 metres high, with stepped red brick courses carrying a two-tier tiled timber pavilion.
